texts.facts: This writ petition has been filed inter alia, praying therein for the following reliefs:- "(i) To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents to permit/allow petitioner to operate and run the business of meat and meat products pursuant to license No. 12725067000005 valid upto 18.01.2026 (as contained in Annexure No. 5 to the writ petition). (ii) To issue an order or direction restraining Respondents from creating any disturbance/hindrance in functioning of business/shop of meant and meat products registered on the license No. 12725067000005." 3.
texts.arguments: Learned Standing Counsel appearing for the State-respondents submits that they are not interfering in the functioning of the petitioner's meat shop.
